title: Air pollution
content: Air pollution is the condition in which air contains a high concentration of air pollutants that may harm living things and also damage non-living things.
e: Air pollution is the condition in which air contains a high concentration of air pollutants that may harm living things and also damage non-living things. Air pollution is a high level of harmful gases or particles in the air.

title: Global warming
content: Global warming is the increase in the Earth's average temperature due to the built-up of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere.
e: Global warming is the increase in the Earth's average temperature due to the built-up of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere. Global warming is the rise in Earth's average temperature from extra greenhouse gases.

title: Acid rain
content: Acid rain is formed when acidic air pollutants mainly sulphur dioxide and nitrogen dioxide react with water in the air (atmosphere).
e: Acid rain is formed when acidic air pollutants mainly sulphur dioxide and nitrogen dioxide react with water in the air (atmosphere). Acid rain forms when sulfur and nitrogen oxides make acidic solutions in rain.

title: Hard water
content: Hard water is water which will not readily form a permanent lather with soap.
e: Hard water is water which will not readily form a permanent lather with soap. Hard water has a lot of calcium and magnesium ions, so soap does not lather well.

title: Soft water
content: Soft water is water which readily gives a permanent lather with soap.
e: Soft water is water which readily gives a permanent lather with soap. Soft water has few calcium and magnesium ions, so soap lathers easily.
